title: Inner Helix Matrix Traversal
description: Given an m x n matrix, your objective is to perform a clockwise spiral traversal. Starting from the top-left corner (0,0), move right until the boundary, then move down, then left, and finally up. Continue this inward winding pattern until every element in the matrix has been visited exactly once.
input_format:
The first line contains two integers m and n, representing the number of rows and columns.
The next m lines each contain n space-separated integers, representing the matrix elements.
output_format: Print all elements of the matrix in spiral order on a single line, separated by spaces.
